text: Because the board draws the same two check marks for two different states. Grey ✓✓ means the board passed your comment on to the clerk. Coloured ✓✓ means the agent marked it seen. The difference is only a colour you can't tell apart at a glance, so it looked as if I had read it. I've added this to CL12: each state gets its own mark, and 'seen' appears only after the agent has actually answered or opened your comment.
